name: ThreeKingdoms
detailed_description:
The game is under development, welcome to add wishlist

This game is based on the framework of "War of Nations 2", is a 2D grand strategy turn-based historical game with the background of The Three Kingdoms.

We are redesigning the gameplay based on the background of The Three Kingdoms. Please look forward to it.

In the game, you will be the hero of the turbulent world, in the 2D realistic picture of The Three Kingdoms of the strategiz, with wisdom, diplomacy and politics to rewrite history! Integrate the battlefield game of platoon and arrangement, maneuver in diplomacy, and enrich the country and strengthen the army's economic strategy to create your own hegemony of the three countries!

【Core Features】
🔥 Epic strategic game

  • The 2D real map recreates the mountains and rivers of the three countries, and more than 100 cities, passes and resource points form a strategic chessboard.

  • Real-time dynamic sand table simulation, terrain, weather, arms restraint are the key to success, each step of the decision need to weigh the pros and cons!

🏹 Platoon, a thousand miles

  • There are hundreds of different types of soldiers, including pikemen, cavalry, archers, cataptors... Build your own army to crush the enemy with formations and tactics!

🤝 Maneuver and unite

  • Alliances, wars, divisions, fraternization... The diplomatic system deeply restores the power of the three countries, and fights with the Confucianist or backs to stab the Allies, all in one read!

  • Dynamic changes in power relations, today's Allies tomorrow's old enemies, only insight into the hearts of the people can be invincible!

💼 Internal affairs management, national strength as the basis

  • Multi-dimensional development of agriculture, commerce, science and technology, balanced distribution of resources, to create a prosperous rear.

  • Talent recruitment, official appointment and removal, resettlement of refugees... The details of internal affairs determine the rise and fall of the nation. Whether tyranny falls quickly or benevolence reigns is up to you.
